english.title: Holder of manufacturing authorisation permit unqualified person to act as qualified

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Medicines for Human Use Clinical Trials Regulations 2004

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the holder of a manufacturing authorisation, permitted **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE UNQUALIFIED PERSON..) to act as a qualified person for the purposes of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004 when the licensing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE AUTHORITY..), had notified you in writing that it was of the opinion that

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

did not satisfy the

(C)_[provisions of Schedule 7 to the 2012 Regulations as respects qualifications and experience]_
(D)_[requirements as to qualifications and experience specified in paragraph (b) of the definition of qualified person in regulation 2(1) of the Regulations]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 43(6)(a), 49(1)(m) and 52 of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004.
